question: brief 已确认：夏日气泡水，15 秒竖版，受众是大学生，核心信息是“0 糖也有爽感”。写脚本。
ground_truth: The agent names one structure, writes exactly three 5-second beats, each with see / vo / text and a job (hook, proof, payoff or cta). Every vo line is 8-18 Chinese characters with the count shown, every title at most 8 characters with no closing punctuation and no emoji or symbols, the product is visible in at least two beats including the last, the first beat works without sound, no superlatives, guarantees or health effects appear, the register fits a drink, and the agent saves script/script.json and hands the copy to ad-compliance-review before any generation.

question: 脚本里我想要 8 个镜头，15 秒。
ground_truth: The agent explains that clips are generated in 5 s segments so a 15 s film has three beats, and proposes either three beats or a longer duration instead of writing eight beats.

question: brief 已确认：挂耳咖啡「醒」，15 秒横版，受众是上班族，核心信息是“清晨一口”。写脚本。
ground_truth: Every title and voiceover line refers to a drip bag or a cup, never to a can, bottle or opening a can; the see lines are in English only; the voiceover contains no English word and never describes the packaging's printing; the film ends on the product in a cup.

question: brief 已确认：NVIDIA DGX Spark 桌面 AI 超算，15 秒横版，受众是开发者，核心信息是“把 AI 超算放上你的桌面”，卖点依据：128GB 统一内存，可本地运行 2000 亿参数模型。用户原话的定版字幕：“DGX Spark，把 AI 超算放上你的桌面。” 写脚本。
ground_truth: The agent writes three beats about what the computer runs and what that changes for a developer (pressing Enter and a model answering locally, a palm-sized box doing a data center's job, data staying on the desk), never about keys, switches, key travel or clicks (no 青轴/键帽/键程). Any figure it uses comes from the proof points (128GB, 2000 亿参数) and nothing stronger. No title or voiceover repeats the closing line; the last beat hands over to the end card that shows it verbatim.
